title: 8.1.10 Lab: Sketch and Pull
description: Draw a flat rectangle and pull it up into a solid. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Draw a rectangle
steps.instructions: Press the Sketch tool in the toolbar. A flat rectangle appears on the ground, 40 mm one way and 25 mm the other.
hints: Nothing is solid yet - a sketch is flat, like a drawing on a piece of paper lying on the ground.

steps.title: Make it 40 x 20
steps.instructions: In the Dimensions panel, find "Sketch 1 corner 3 up" - it reads 25. Type 20 there. reSHape keeps the sketch a rectangle, so "Sketch 1 corner 4 up" usually follows to 20 on its own; if it still reads 25, type 20 there too. The rectangle is now 40 mm by 20 mm.
hints: The width side (40) is already correct - you're only changing the 25s.
Watch the rectangle in the 3D view get shorter on one side as you type.

steps.title: Pull it into a solid
steps.instructions: With the sketch selected, press the Pull tool. In the Dimensions panel, type 10 in the height field.
hints: The rectangle turns into a solid block standing 10 mm tall.
Look for the field named "Pull 1 height" in the Dimensions panel.

requirements.title: A 40 x 20 rectangle pulled 10 mm tall
requirements.description: A flat 40 mm by 20 mm rectangle, pulled into a solid 10 mm tall.
requirements.hint: Press Sketch, set both 25 fields to 20, then press Pull and type 10.
